scope: Deterministic algorithmic qualification model for per-cell charge inhibition; not firmware, analog hardware, power-stage, PCB, 0V startup, or physical acceptance.
energy_sensitivity_note: Illustrative BUS power and duration only. Actual startup transient demand is unspecified; 1s is a reference sensitivity, not a user requirement or release gate.

adc_gpio_stress_inputs.qualification_status: Conditional stress arithmetic only: data-sheet ADC accuracy is characterized rather than per-unit guaranteed; mixed ADC mapping, actual VREF, board conditions, RC settling and system calibration are not closed.

sc_minus_candidate.qualification_status: Candidate arithmetic only; current/shunt compensation accuracy is not specified or qualified.

unknown_or_unclosed_measurement_terms: Production/end-to-end absolute cell-voltage error across all eight channels and temperature; E<=100mV is a qualification requirement, not a measured fact.
VREF/VDDA accuracy and variation over temperature, supply and load.
Mixed ADC1/ADC2 channel-specific residual error and calibration stability.
Actual RC capacitor, input network settling, sample-and-hold timing, and channel scan schedule.
PCB contamination/leakage, harness leakage, noise, ground offsets and transient coupling.
SC- shunt-side voltage/current compensation residual for cell 1 and total SC voltage.
End-to-end detection-to-zero-current response; 50ms is a model qualification limit, not a measurement.
IWDG/reset cannot independently cover every MCU stuck GPIO/PWM/peripheral failure.
historical_result_boundary: LICAP350F V1.5 energy/SPICE results are historical only and are not re-labeled or used as current BUSFIX verification.
